findings.text: _queued_review_run_fields calls runs.list_live(project=project) and queue_admission.queued_placements once per review-duty row, although obligations() already holds live_pointers at obligations.py:1455 and computes placements once at obligations.py:1433-1456; a view with many review-missing rows re-reads every live pointer file and re-orders the queue per row.

the queued-review subject sweep duplicates the one recovery_review_dispatch.py:491 _review_in_flight owns; it reuses that module's _review_subject, _is_review_run and _review_head_covers helpers but not its sweep, so a change to how a review's subject and head are recognised has to be made in two places.
